correctness.rationale: T is elapsed time to the first nonidentity spatial symmetry, with T=0 for initially symmetric words, counting indexed words. In the cyclic module over F_q with modulus z^n-1, for each d|n the period-dividing-d condition at time t is the kernel of (z^d-1)(1-z)^t. The kernel dimension is the degree of its gcd with z^n-1: writing n=p^a m and d=p^b d0 with p not dividing m,d0, z^d-1 divides z^n-1 and has root-1 multiplicity p^b, so the dimension is d+min(t,p^a-p^b). This includes a=0. Commutation makes symmetry persistent, so M_t=#(T>t) is precisely the Möbius inversion sum over d|n of mu(n/d) times q to that kernel dimension. M_0=B_q(n). If p does not divide n the sum is time independent. Otherwise, only terms with b=a or b=a-1 survive; the latter have d=n/(pr), r|rad(m), and mu(pr)=-mu(r). Hence M_t=B_q(n)-(q^min(t,L)-1)H_q(n,p). Taking differences and the eventual constant gives precisely the finite, zero-time and infinite masses. H counts words of length n/p avoiding all prime-order symmetries from primes dividing m, so is positive (use a word with one marked site, or the vacuous one-site case). This ensures the sharp cutoff and well-defined conditional reverse-lag law, obtained by dividing by (q^L-1)H. For every prime ell different from p, the kernel dimension d=n/ell is constant in time, and the preimage kernels are nested, so such a symmetry cannot first appear. Any wholly new nontrivial stabilizer therefore contains the order-p subgroup. For m=1 the formula gives M_L=0. A commuting unit factor preserves each shift fixed subspace bijectively, so it preserves each word's clock, not just the distribution. Independently compared direct entry-or-repeat simulations with the per-divisor kernel-count formula in 26 rings over F_2, F_3, F_4 and F_9: all 30852 initial words agreed in the complete histograms. Replay: python3 /workspace/independent_replays.py 3.

value.rationale: The invariant quantitatively refines general symmetry irreversibility for a canonical cyclic linear rule: a period drop may never occur, but if it occurs after time zero it has a characteristic-prime cutoff and an exact reversed lag law independent of the prime-to-p factor. Counting every start and showing pointwise invariance under multiplication of the rule by a unit make this structural rather than an isolated cycle enumeration.
residual_risks: Does not address nonunit rules, multidimensional tori, nonlinear dynamics or nonuniform initial ensembles.
